headline: Cops let Kodak finish food before custody
body: DJ Akademiks reports cops gave Kodak grace to eat his meal before arresting him. The post, with 22K likes and 856 comments, claims officers allowed the rapper to complete his food before placing him in custody. This story has sparked debate about police procedures and celebrity interactions with law enforcement.
